title: ACNH prologue landing: UID EventPlaza preset to SetupActorPosition(Type=3)
scope: Static join of FieldMainFieldParam.UniqueID/EventPlaza rows with the landing EventFlow and native Type=3 position request. No executable rebuild or runtime tracing performed.

answer.short: The UID-selected EventPlaza preset pair flows through the EventPlaza loader into a saved pair and then into the same native global anchor returned to SetupActorPosition(Type=3). Type=3 samples the current root-grid ground and forms an offset position request from that anchor. This is a proven indirect input relationship, not proof that the pair itself is a named player or airplane spawn coordinate.
answer.confidence_boundary: Proven: static data/control-flow and shared-object relation. Unproven: decoded hash names/units/origin, whether the target request is applied specifically to the player or airplane, and whether this is the final visible landing location.

relevant_events.interpretation: Literal switch value 0 reaches Event3; value 1 reaches Event0. Do not assume bool polarity.

relevant_events.note: Camera uses target Npc:rco and parameter key EventPlazaPrologue; this is not the Type=3 actor-target proof.

eventflow.branch: The literal case value 0 path goes through messages 003/004, wait/fade, then Event5 Type=3. Case value 1 goes to messages 001/002 and terminates.

native.address_convention: PCs/targets below are raw main.elf VAs from the ELF analysis inventory. Decompiler symbol labels commonly appear +0x100000 above the raw VA; do not mix the two address domains.

call_edges.effect: gets the shared EventPlaza anchor object at global+0x40
samples/adjusts a position against the current root-grid context (root+0x28)
fills request data from derived position/transform
dispatches request through a generic callback list

type3_block.position_logic: Uses the anchor returned by 0x469680; root-grid helper 0x1577a0 is called before emitting the request. Decompiled case-3 logic includes horizontal offsets -7.5 and +15.0 and caller-supplied height. Treat these as request-transform offsets, not proven player spawn coordinates.
type3_block.generic_dispatch: 0xca4370 iterates a callback/list at receiver offsets +0xb70/+0xb78 and invokes the callback vtable. It does not identify an actor class or prove player/airplane identity.

shared_anchor.object_offset_relation: updater param1 is global+0x10; param1+0x30 equals global+0x40, exactly the pointer returned by 0x469680 and consumed by Type=3.
shared_anchor.updater_data_use: 0x47c1e0 obtains a pair via 0xf74c30, passes it to 0x52bcf0, then calls 0x52c5f0(param1+8,param1+0x30) to update the shared position object. The pair getter 0xf74c30 reads saved SaveMainField offsets +0xcfa2c and +0xcfa30.

eventplaza_inventory.interpretation: Each table row selects the same FieldData stem used to locate <FieldData>_EventPlaza.json. Its two integer hash fields are copied into the saved pair by the native loader. Hash names remain unresolved in the local native evidence.

external_alignment.status: External schema alignment only (Treeki/CylindricalEarth schema/version); do not treat these field names as proven local native names or use them to assign units/origin.

what_remains_unproven: The meaning, axis ordering, units, and origin of the two BYML hashes h_035daede and h_799dfdbe in local native code.

Whether the shared EventPlaza anchor is the intended player spawn or airplane/arrival actor spawn. The Type=3 handler emits a generic callback request and no player/airplane identity was found in the traced path.
Whether this request is the final visible landing position versus an intermediate actor placement/camera setup.
Runtime confirmation of the selection-to-world-init handoff and ground result for an actual selected UID.
conversion_notes: Keep all 96 UID→FieldData→EventPlaza rows and both integer hash values verbatim; do not rename or rescale the hashes without further native proof.

Reproduce the static relation: selected UID resolves FieldData, EventPlaza values populate the shared anchor, Type=3 reads the anchor, samples root-grid ground, then adds the observed offsets before generic dispatch.
Keep the Npc:rco EventPlazaPrologue camera target as a separate camera cue; it is not a substitute for the Type=3 position target.
Do not label Type=3 as player spawn in an implementation until the generic callback receiver is identified.
